neighbours.label: ' to' right where a stock verdict idiom is being set up: 'a sight/spectacle to (behold)', 'nothing to (sneeze at / write home about)', 'not much to (look at)', 'a force to (be reckoned with)', 'puts X to (shame)', 'and looks to (boot)'; ordinary purpose or direction 'to' (a place to visit, wants to go, drove to town) stays quiet, and so does 'a tough act to follow'
neighbours.short: ' to' setting up a stock verdict idiom (a sight to behold)
fire: The northern lights over the frozen lake were a sight to behold.
A ten percent raise in this economy is nothing to sneeze at.
Honestly, the hotel breakfast was nothing to write home about.
The old cabin wasn't much to look at, but it was warm.
By her second season, the rookie had become a force to be reckoned with.
His garden puts the professional landscapers to shame.
The fireworks finale was a spectacle to behold, even for the bored teenagers.
The new phone is lighter, faster, and looks to boot.

She wants to finish the report tonight.
